method_change_limit: Native measurement fixture and declarative contract only; independent comparator is the comparison arm, not a core repair.
source_versions: Exact archived upstream trees. No setup.py execution, pip, package install, code patch, dependency resolver, external service or source substitution.

runtime.selection_basis: Existing system interpreter, selected without importing historical Click or observing its compatibility.
runtime.dependency_plan: Load exact source tree directly after review. Standard library only for our fixture; installed site packages disabled. Incompatibility, missing dependency or unsupported runtime means HOLD on this case, no repair or reinstall.

operations: Construct a Context over an otherwise empty Command with a string obj token.
Enter and exit that Context; let __exit__ invoke cleanup.
Construct the same Context and callback.
Call its public close() explicitly while it is current.
Exit normally. The source close() clears callbacks, so the later automatic close is naturally empty.

measurements.callback: Call public get_current_context(silent=True) once per callback; immediately record identity (current is target) and current.obj or null when no current context. Never transport a Context object.
measurements.raw_lists: All callbacks retained in order. Feed their complete identity Boolean list and object token/null list to both arms; expected singleton lists also encode exactly one callback without a precomputed pass flag.
measurements.after_scope: Record get_current_context(silent=True) is None immediately after exit.
measurements.context_limit: Declared fixture identity, not independent proof against forged context or stale/omitted observations.

native_reference.fixture: Extract and run only fixed snapshot tests/test_context.py::test_close_before_pop AST function with the exact Click module under test and its CliRunner. No pytest import, no other upstream tests executed.
native_reference.mode: Two separately logged reference pilot processes, before then fixed; normal optimization only.
native_reference.expected_from_source: Before must fail specifically because its cleanup callback cannot access a current context; fixed must pass exact upstream assertions. Import, encoding, dependency or unrelated errors are environment/reference HOLD, not bug confirmation.
native_reference.formal_release: Parent nonauthor review must first approve packet; then reference pilots must close causal oracle agreement before any formal cells. Remaining 2 permitted pilots are reserved for a reviewer-approved non-outcome-selected infrastructure diagnostic, never parameter/fixture tuning.

comparison.input_equality: One saved JSON context/samples object, identical bytes or hashed canonical JSON supplied to both arms; no native assertion pass flags as samples.
comparison.core_api: frozen_core.evaluate(trace, contract); caller loads verified unchanged parent core. Core output-key normalization must be mechanical and retain ordered missing paths, invalid IDs and relation IDs.
comparison.baseline: rich_baseline.py is hard-coded independently from the core and contract interpreter; no core import, no core outputs, no contract traversal.
comparison.domain: Finite built-in JSON, exact context/samples envelope. All required paths resolved before eligibility; missing -> UNSUPPORTED, eligibility mismatch -> INVALID, else failed ordered relations -> DETECTED or INVARIANT. Bool distinct from numbers. Ordered missing paths represented as arrays of path components in the baseline.
comparison.native_types: Boolean identity list, string/null object list and Boolean after-exit value. Malformed native types or target exceptions are retained as HOLD, not coerced.
comparison.review_required: Reviewer verifies relation obligation label compatibility and exact core output normalization before native launch; baseline-only synthetic QA is not core parity proof.
comparison.claims: Expressibility/parity/cost for one documented lifecycle property only. No new defect discovery, superiority or general Python-object transport claim.

execution.order: fixed project order; before/trigger, before/benign, fixed/trigger, fixed/benign; repeats 1..3

gate.parent_responsibility: Independently confirm reviewer identity/non-authorship, adjudicate limits, enforce sequential launch/timeout/output bounds, retain raw commands/stdout/stderr and counters, and mechanically compare core/baseline outputs. This packet is not an execution release.
